name: Saving Yenniku
summary: Kin'weelay has found a way to bring Yenniku home from Zanzil the Outcast. He reshapes the recovered Mind's Eye into a soul gem that can stun Yenniku and hold his spirit until you take it to Nimboya.

sections.title: A Vessel for the Spirit
sections.body: Kin'weelay turns the recovered Mind's Eye into a magical soul gem. Its enchantment lets you stun Yenniku and set the stone on his head to capture his spirit. With Yenniku's spirit inside, you can carry the gem safely to his kin at Grom'gol Base Camp.

sections.title: The Outcast's Lair
sections.body: Zanzil the Outcast holds Yenniku in the Ruins of Aboraz, along the Crystal Shore on the southern Cape of Stranglethorn. You enter Zanzil's territory and use the gem to break the witch doctor's hold over the young troll. Then you carry the filled gem back to Nimboya.

faq.q: Who provides the Soul Gem for this task?
aliases: where do I get the soul gem
faq.answer: Kin'weelay makes the Soul Gem from the recovered Mind's Eye and gives it to you to capture Yenniku's spirit.
Yenniku is with Zanzil the Outcast at the Ruins of Aboraz, along the Crystal Shore on the Cape of Stranglethorn.

faq.q: How does the Soul Gem work?
aliases: what does the soul gem do
faq.answer: The Soul Gem first stuns Yenniku. Then you place it on his head to draw his spirit inside.

faq.q: Who receives the Filled Soul Gem once Yenniku is secured?
aliases: where to turn in filled soul gem
faq.answer: You deliver the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya at Grom'gol Base Camp.

angles.text: As a troll, you help bring young Darkspear Yenniku back toward his people and free him from Zanzil the Outcast's vile magic.
As a Horde adventurer from Grom'gol Base Camp, you carry Nimboya's search for Yenniku to Zanzil at the Ruins of Aboraz.
